Not for customer distribution.

Finding F-012: Silverline Pumps Ltd, contract C-2028, SKU MFG-1005.

Issue: The contractual annual price escalation was never applied in billing. Clause A.1 sets the base price at USD 593.00 per unit. Clause 4.2 requires a 2.5% compounding increase on each anniversary of the Effective Date.

Calculation: USD 593.00 x (1 + 2.5%) [2024-05-01] x (1 + 2.5%) [2025-05-01] = USD 623.02 (latest expected). Latest billed: USD 593.00.

Impact: 20 invoice lines, 2024-05-15 to 2025-12-15. Potential underbilling is USD 22,246.10. Estimated recoverable amount is USD 19,954.75.

Recommended action (owner: Pricing & Billing Master Data): Load the escalated Unit Price into the billing price master from 2024-05-15. Prepare a supplementary invoice for the under-billed lines for approval.

No invoice is to be issued until the billing manager and finance controller approve."}
